comparison.objective: Stand a 1 kg filament spool up and slide it onto a holder rod until it reaches the stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual heavy-object reorientation, bore-to-rod alignment, and insertion; no unlocking, rotary tuning, or torque-limited relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Spool threaded squarely onto a rod with 7 mm bore clearance and advanced to the stop; exact contact tolerance is missing.
comparison.reason: Tests cooperative load alignment and shaft insertion, a meaningfully different ability from damper commissioning.
